scope: Publish shared new-cell geometry and the unadopted strict/exact experiment.
limitations: GPU timing improvements do not meet the wide comparable-quality native CPU goal.

The initial production graded candidate had one CPU quota-throttled period; its mesh/timings are retained separately and a fresh complete pair was required. Three preceding clean pairs are retained in the primary cohort.

The private strict/exact v2 experiment adds no useful benefit over simple v1 and is not adopted. Its full evidence is retained. The simple grid harness system-Python import failure and explicit-venv retry are retained.
Retained-grid stress timing excludes initial full construction and is not fresh VTM timing.
Native trace/observer/sanitizer times are diagnostic, not clean performance samples.
Fresh solves exclude setup, compilation, upload and serialization; workspace pool memory is not process peak memory.
The first captured-loop launch includes deferred graph instantiation/upload before its single graph launch; no claim of zero driver-internal host work.
Known Armadillo extraction failures and comparable-quality CPU limitations remain open.
reproduction: Restore original .work/vtm paths, shared helpers and prior inputs in checkouts of pinned source commits. Replace the absolute workspace root as needed; drivers refuse overwrites.

Private prototypes use baselinea4f7215. Production has no private installer. Source/kernel AST checks bind the promoted kernels to simple v1. Additional simple8k/grid candidates use retained fresh v2 controls, not new interleaved pairs.

Use PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WARP_CACHE_PATH=/opt/warpower-generated-cache OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 PYTHONPATH=.:.work/vtm. One GPU process at a time; no heavy CPU during clean timing.
Build native validators from benchmarks/cpu; binary hashes retained. /opt holds only regenerable caches/scratch.
